Magnesium hydroxide reduces ciprofloxacin levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Administer ciprofloxacin at least 2 hours before or 6 hours after products containing multivalent cations, as coadministration can reduce ciprofloxacin bioavailability by up to 90%. Use alternatives if available. 3. Magnesium hydroxide decreases crizotinib levels by increasing gastric pH, which reduces its solubility and bioavailability. This interaction applies only to oral forms of both agents. Separate administration by at least 2 hours. 5. Magnesium hydroxide reduces deferiprone levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption.
